sloka: न विन्दते तत्र तु शर्म मैथिलीविरूप नेत्राभिः अतीव तर्जिता ।पतिम् स्मरन्ती दयितम् च देवरम्विचेतना अभूत् भय शोक पीडिता ॥३-५६-३६॥
transliteration: na vindate tatra tu śarma maithilīvirūpa netrābhiḥ atīva tarjitā ।patim smarantī dayitam ca devaramvicetanā abhūt bhaya śoka pīḍitā ॥3-56-36॥

translations.english: Sita had no peace as she was threatened excessively by those women of deformed looks. Remembering her beloved husband who was also her god, and overtaken by fear and grief , she fell unconscious. इतयार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षटपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftysixth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
